categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Touches build system and depends macOS SDK configuration; carries the 'Build system' and 'macOS' labels.
categories.rationale: Bumping the macOS SDK to 15.0 unblocks the planned upgrade of Qt in depends to 6.12 LTS. As stated in the commit description, 'Qt 6.12, which supports deployment targets up to macOS 26, requires the macOS 15 SDK or higher... This is a prerequisite for the upcoming update of Qt in depends from 6.8 LTS to 6.12 LTS.' This is routine dependency maintenance that can be deferred without causing build breakage.
